purpose: Guarantee that every raw observation for every named algorithm and every recorded metric is preserved, traceable, independently exportable, and deliverable without relying on an analysis result or an aggregation-only file.

replacementArtifacts: original failed or voided lane artifacts retained in place with eligibility labels

level1SampleRun.unit: one named algorithm lane in one superblock
level1SampleRun.content: all lane-level raw fields, eligibility, failure state, execution identity, input binding, process binding, block summaries, and source path/hash

level2MetricLong.unit: one atomic recorded metric value at one declared measurement point
level2MetricLong.content: metricId, raw value, unit, numeric type, measurement boundary, numerator/denominator/components where applicable, presence flag, missing-reason code, source path/hash

level3EventGroup.unit: one complete same-tick event group in one algorithm lane
level3EventGroup.content: all ApplyChanges records, all mandatory post-event Plan query records for all N agents, elapsed time, grid-read components, allocation bytes, status/version/correctness fields, and source binding

level4OperationEventQuery.unit: one input change operation, one event, or one post-event query
level4OperationEventQuery.content: ordered lossless trace with operation/event/query identity, coordinates or bundle reference, timestamps or deterministic sequence counters, agent identity, result status, raw instrumentation values, native diagnostics with semantics ID, and source binding

level5StateMeasurement.content: primitive-array bytes, per-container capacity records, total logical persistent bytes, audited formula version, and source binding

level6FailureReplacement.unit: one lane failure, infrastructure failure, or whole-superblock replacement decision
level6FailureReplacement.content: original attempt, categorization, eligibility, reason, replacement linkage, timestamps, process identity, evidence paths and hashes

D1: block geometric mean and nearest-rank P95 retained as derivable summaries
D4: every named container capacity and per-unit formula component
persistentStateBytesTotal at every required measurement point
rawFieldRetention.D5ThroughD7: retain all D1 constituent observations and all frozen complexity-axis values; slope estimates alone are not raw data
rawFieldRetention.secondaryEndpoints: retain every recorded initialization, cold-query, native diagnostic, reliability, correctness, oracle, and retained movement-transfer observation
rawFieldRetention.ratiosAndPercentages: retain numerator, denominator, and eligibility population; a percentage alone is insufficient
rawFieldRetention.nonFiniteValues: never silently coerce, drop, or replace; preserve token, field, reason and eligibility disposition

expectedStructuralCardinality.exactOperationCardinality: must reconcile to the frozen input bundle, F, atomic partition schedule, 24 event groups, and N post-event queries

files.role: one row per named algorithm lane with complete lane-level raw and eligibility fields
lossless portable long table containing every atomic metric observation
typed machine-efficient equivalent of the metric-long table
typed machine-efficient equivalent of the event-group table
ordered operation, event, and post-event query trace
all state measurement points and per-container components
complete failure, eligibility, voiding, and replacement ledger
field semantics, units, types, allowed missing reasons, metric boundaries, and native diagnostic semantics
study, design, input, build, executable, source, schema, exporter, validator, and measured-root bindings
path, byte size, record count, schema version, and SHA-256 for every export artifact
deterministic canonical inventory of the delivery package

formatRules.csv: UTF-8, RFC 4180 compatible, invariant-culture numeric serialization, explicit NA reason fields
formatRules.parquet: lossless typed mirror of the corresponding long table with declared schema fingerprint
formatRules.jsonl: UTF-8, one complete JSON object per line, deterministic record ordering
formatRules.compression: Zstandard with compression metadata recorded; decompressed SHA-256 and record count also recorded

formalRawCommitGate.ifGateFails: preserve measured root and failure evidence; do not analyze, top up, merge, restart, or create a replacement attempt without new user authorization

prohibitions: no deletion of failed, voided, excluded, or replacement-source observations
no unlabeled merging across study, phase, attempt, algorithm, cell, superblock, lane, event group, query, or measurement point
no treating operations, agents, events, event groups, frames, ticks, cells, or lanes as independent statistical n
no transformation that prevents reconstruction of the original raw value
no analysis result required to understand or retrieve a raw record
no overwriting prior Gate14Re, Gate14Re-TB, Gate14Re-TB2, Gate13R, or Gate13R-AX2 artifacts
